Optional follow-ons after v1 qualification: TimeBanded crossover, bounded-state approximations of Gaussian/LWU, continuous coefficient interpolation, expected-information curvature, Gram-delay cache reuse, and finite-state random box/multiphase drive augmentation. They are not hidden requirements for v1, and cannot silently replace named families or observed curvature. No implementation claim is made by lodging this epic.
